findings.summary: `pnpm typecheck` exited 1 twice. pnpm's pre-run dependency check started `pnpm install` because the concurrent unit phase-7-backend-release changed package.json. The postinstall (scripts/prepare-app.mjs --migrate) then failed in `prisma migrate deploy` with 'SQLite database error: database is locked': the Play preview is running on :3543 (.aioson/preview.json) and holds data/fitpulse.db. No type error was involved. The script body, `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit`, exited 0. The logs are typecheck-attempt1.log, typecheck-attempt1-retry.log and tsc-direct-attempt1.log in the run temp dir.

The full store smoke (8 steps) was not rerun here. The script belongs to the concurrent phase-7-backend-release unit, which is still under review, and the rerun was assigned to integration. The rename that blocked step 1/8 is now present in the tree.
